answer_text: Not necessarily broken. The “Not Ready (In HA Failover)” state can occur during a manual HA failover and is addressed in the HA status documentation. Manual failover tests should be kept short and the HA state should be returned to Ready promptly. Before performing a manual failover, ensure both Sockets are on vSocket 24+ and CMA shows Ready; if Not Ready persists, follow the Not Ready troubleshooting guidance in the KB to resolve before re-testing.
